**Verified 2026-07-13** (without the migration applied yet — see below): `npm test`/`tsc`/`eslint` all clean across every touched file. Browser: `/kalkulator-hpp` still renders normally with a new CTA to `/kalkulator-hpp/beli`; that page correctly shows the WhatsApp/email manual-payment buttons (not a broken Midtrans call) since `BILLING_MANUAL_MODE=true`; `/kalkulator-hpp/beli/selesai?order_id=<fake>` gracefully shows "Pesanan tidak ditemukan" instead of crashing (though this doesn't distinguish "order not found" from "migration not applied yet" — both currently degrade the same way, which is fine for the user-facing message but means this test alone doesn't prove the migration is live).

**Migrations applied 2026-07-13**: both `20260713120000_drop_hpp_standalone_tool.sql` (drops the abandoned AI-web-tool tables) and `20260713130000_hpp_desktop_orders.sql` (creates `hpp_desktop_orders` + `get_hpp_order_status` RPC) were pasted into the Supabase SQL Editor and ran successfully — user confirmed "udah sukses semua". The purchase flow's DB layer is now live end-to-end.

**Real price set 2026-07-13**: `src/lib/billing/desktop-products.ts` price changed from the Rp49.000 placeholder to **Rp69.000** (user's explicit final price) — the "edit before going live" comment was removed since this is now final.

**Midtrans verification status (checked 2026-07-13 via user screenshot)**: account activation is at step 3 of 4 — "Account registration" done, "Business registration" done, **"Business review" in progress**, "Result" not yet out. So `BILLING_MANUAL_MODE` stays on for now (buyers go through WhatsApp/email manual contact); this is expected to flip once Midtrans finishes reviewing and issues real Access Keys (Server Key/Client Key) — user needs to tell a future session when that happens so the manual mode can be turned off and real keys wired in.

**Free web calculator (`/kalkulator-hpp`, the separate always-free lead-magnet tool, not the sold desktop app) got a small addition same day**: a static CSS mockup component `src/app/kalkulator-hpp/desktop-app-preview.tsx` (window-chrome bar + green sidebar + stat cards + mini bar chart, all decorative divs styled with the same brand-500/600/700 colors, no real data) was added inside the existing "Cuma Butuh Kalkulator HPP-nya Saja?" card in `hpp-calculator.tsx`, right before the "Lihat Aplikasi Desktop" CTA link — gives visitors a visual peek at the desktop app's look before clicking through to `/kalkulator-hpp/beli`. This is NOT a real screenshot (Electron app runs locally on the buyer's machine, no way to capture one from this environment) — purely an illustrative mockup. Verified in browser: renders correctly, colors resolve to the correct brand green, no console errors.

**How to apply**: before touching this feature again, confirm both pending migrations are applied, and check whether the user has attempted the `.exe` build themselves (Developer Mode / Administrator) — if so, the installer needs to land at `private-assets/kalkulator-hpp-desktop-setup.exe` for downloads to actually work.

**UI redesign, same day 2026-07-13**: user rejected the original flat two-card layout ("saya ga mau tampilan seperti itu") and requested a full redesign — approved via an interactive HTML mockup shown through `mcp__visualize__show_widget` *before* touching real code (user's explicit standing instruction for this feature: preview first, "jangan langsung jadi tiba-tiba tanpa saya iyakan"). Iterated through 3 mockup rounds (color/icons/layout feedback, then added features) before getting final go-ahead ("oke manteb... lanjut kerjakan"). Implemented in `desktop-app/`:
- **Layout**: left sidebar nav (Dashboard / Bahan Baku / Menu) replacing the old stacked-cards page; colors now match KasirKu's actual brand green (`--color-brand-500 #00a651` family from `src/app/globals.css`), not the generic blue used in the first mockup draft — user explicitly rejected black sidebars and emoji-style icons (all nav/action icons are inline line-style SVGs now).
- **Dashboard**: stat cards (Total Menu, Total Bahan Baku, Rata-rata Margin, Rata-rata HPP + its %-of-selling-price sub-line) plus two charts — a wide horizontal-bar "Rata-rata HPP per Kategori" (grouped by menu category) and a deliberately small/narrow vertical-bar "Margin per Menu" (user asked to shrink this one — "kecilkan bar bagian kanan").
- **Bahan Baku**: added Excel/CSV import (`xlsx` npm package, parsed in the **main process** via a new `dialog:importExcel` IPC handler — renderer has no filesystem access since `nodeIntegration: false`; column matching is fuzzy on header names containing "nama/name/bahan", "satuan/unit", "harga/cost/price"). Import upserts by case-insensitive name match (updates price if the ingredient already exists, else adds new).
- **Menu**: `menuItems` gained `category` (free text) and `sellingPrice` fields (previously only had `targetMarginPercent`); table now shows Menu/Kategori/Total HPP/Harga Jual/%HPP/Margin with click-to-expand detail rows (edit category+price, manage recipe lines) — same interaction pattern as the old ingredient/menu cards, just reshaped into table rows.
- **Menu Bundling (new entity)**: `state.bundles` — a bundle references existing `menuItems` by id+qty; its HPP is simply the sum of each component menu's own `computeHpp()` × qty (no separate ingredient list). Has its own sellingPrice/%HPP/margin computed the same way as single menus. Lives in a second subtab within the Menu panel ("Menu Satuan" / "Menu Bundling").
- **Sidebar category nav**: clicking "Menu" in the sidebar expands a sub-list of categories (derived dynamically from `menuItems`, deduped, "Tanpa Kategori" fallback for blank categories) — clicking one filters the Menu Satuan table and shows a breadcrumb.
- **Download HPP Menu**: button in Menu Satuan exports the current table (Menu/Kategori/Total HPP/Harga Jual/%HPP/Margin) to `.xlsx` via a new `dialog:exportMenuHpp` IPC handler (main process writes the file after a native save dialog) — confirmed with user as Excel format, not CSV.
- **Backup / Pulihkan Data**: two buttons in the sidebar footer. Backup writes the entire `electron-store` contents (`ingredients`/`menuItems`/`bundles`) to a single `.json` file the user picks via native save dialog (`dialog:backupData`); Restore reads a `.json` file back (`dialog:restoreData`, validates the three arrays exist), asks for confirmation (it overwrites current data), then persists. Confirmed with user as JSON format, not Excel — "paling aman untuk dipulihkan persis sama seperti semula".
- All three new IPC handlers (`dialog:importExcel`, `dialog:exportMenuHpp`, `dialog:backupData`, `dialog:restoreData`) live in `main.js` alongside the existing `data:get`/`data:set`, and are bridged through `preload.js` the same `contextBridge` way as before — no change to the `contextIsolation: true` / `nodeIntegration: false` security posture.
- Verified: `node --check` on all three JS files, cross-checked every `getElementById` id in `renderer.js` against `index.html` (all match), `npm start` launches Electron cleanly twice in a row (only benign GPU/network-service sandbox log lines, no JS errors). **User ran it themselves (`cd desktop-app && npm start`, not the root project's `npm start` which is the Next.js web app and was the source of one false-alarm error) and confirmed the new UI visually — "oke udah cocok".** Redesign is now considered done and approved.

**How to apply:** log in at /login with these credentials, then navigate to /business/<id>/... pages. Note: Turbopack on the slow G: drive sometimes serves stale CSS after globals.css edits — `rm -rf .next` and restart the dev server if new Tailwind utilities don't apply. See [[supabase-migrations-manual]]. The POS PIN keypad (pin-screen.tsx) is plain React state, not a real input — driving it with `preview_eval` by firing all 4 digit clicks in one synchronous block silently fails (React batches the clicks and reads a stale `pin` closure each time, so it never reaches length 4 and neither succeeds nor shows an error). Use separate calls per digit, one per tool call, so each click gets its own render cycle. **Update 2026-07-10**: even one-at-a-time, the `preview_click` *tool* (as opposed to `preview_eval`) reliably failed to register on these digit buttons at all — no server action ever fired (confirmed via server logs showing zero `verifyPin` calls), tried across a fresh page load, multiple reloads, and 1-3s waits between clicks. Switching each digit press to `preview_eval` with `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.grid.grid-cols-3.gap-3 button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '<digit>').click()` worked on the very first attempt. If `preview_click` ever seems unresponsive on this keypad (or similar plain-onClick grids) again, don't assume the PIN/credentials are wrong — switch to the `preview_eval` `.click()` approach first.

# PDF Processing Guide

## Overview

This guide covers essential PDF processing operations using Python libraries and command-line tools. For advanced features, JavaScript libraries, and detailed examples, see REFERENCE.md. If you need to fill out a PDF form, read FORMS.md and follow its instructions.

## Quick Start

```python
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# Read a PDF
reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
print(f"Pages: {len(reader.pages)}")

# Extract text
text = ""
for page in reader.pages:
    text += page.extract_text()
```

## Python Libraries

### pypdf - Basic Operations

#### Merge PDFs
```python
from pypdf import PdfWriter, PdfReader

writer = PdfWriter()
for pdf_file in ["doc1.pdf", "doc2.pdf", "doc3.pdf"]:
    reader = PdfReader(pdf_file)
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

with open("merged.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)
```

#### Split PDF
```python
reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(page)
    with open(f"page_{i+1}.pdf", "wb") as output:
        writer.write(output)
```

#### Extract Metadata
```python
reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
meta = reader.metadata
print(f"Title: {meta.title}")
print(f"Author: {meta.author}")
print(f"Subject: {meta.subject}")
print(f"Creator: {meta.creator}")
```

#### Rotate Pages
```python
reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
writer = PdfWriter()

page = reader.pages[0]
page.rotate(90)  # Rotate 90 degrees clockwise
writer.add_page(page)

with open("rotated.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)
```

### pdfplumber - Text and Table Extraction

#### Extract Text with Layout
```python
import pdfplumber

with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    for page in pdf.pages:
        text = page.extract_text()
        print(text)
```

#### Extract Tables
```python
with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages):
        tables = page.extract_tables()
        for j, table in enumerate(tables):
            print(f"Table {j+1} on page {i+1}:")
            for row in table:
                print(row)
```

#### Advanced Table Extraction
```python
import pandas as pd

with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    all_tables = []
    for page in pdf.pages:
        tables = page.extract_tables()
        for table in tables:
            if table:  # Check if table is not empty
                df = pd.DataFrame(table[1:], columns=table[0])
                all_tables.append(df)

# Combine all tables
if all_tables:
    combined_df = pd.concat(all_tables, ignore_index=True)
    combined_df.to_excel("extracted_tables.xlsx", index=False)
```

### reportlab - Create PDFs

#### Basic PDF Creation
```python
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

c = canvas.Canvas("hello.pdf", pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Add text
c.drawString(100, height - 100, "Hello World!")
c.drawString(100, height - 120, "This is a PDF created with reportlab")

# Add a line
c.line(100, height - 140, 400, height - 140)

# Save
c.save()
```

#### Create PDF with Multiple Pages
```python
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, PageBreak
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet

doc = SimpleDocTemplate("report.pdf", pagesize=letter)
styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
story = []

# Add content
title = Paragraph("Report Title", styles['Title'])
story.append(title)
story.append(Spacer(1, 12))

body = Paragraph("This is the body of the report. " * 20, styles['Normal'])
story.append(body)
story.append(PageBreak())

# Page 2
story.append(Paragraph("Page 2", styles['Heading1']))
story.append(Paragraph("Content for page 2", styles['Normal']))

# Build PDF
doc.build(story)
```

#### Subscripts and Superscripts

**IMPORTANT**: Never use Unicode subscript/superscript characters (₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉, ⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹) in ReportLab PDFs. The built-in fonts do not include these glyphs, causing them to render as solid black boxes.

Instead, use ReportLab's XML markup tags in Paragraph objects:
```python
from reportlab.platypus import Paragraph
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet

styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
```

## Command-Line Tools

### pdftotext (poppler-utils)
```bash
# Extract text
pdftotext input.pdf output.txt

# Extract text preserving layout
pdftotext -layout input.pdf output.txt

# Extract specific pages
pdftotext -f 1 -l 5 input.pdf output.txt  # Pages 1-5
```

### qpdf
```bash
# Merge PDFs
qpdf --empty --pages file1.pdf file2.pdf -- merged.pdf

# Split pages
qpdf input.pdf --pages . 1-5 -- pages1-5.pdf
qpdf input.pdf --pages . 6-10 -- pages6-10.pdf

# Rotate pages
qpdf input.pdf output.pdf --rotate=+90:1  # Rotate page 1 by 90 degrees

# Remove password
qpdf --password=mypassword --decrypt encrypted.pdf decrypted.pdf
```

### pdftk (if available)
```bash
# Merge
pdftk file1.pdf file2.pdf cat output merged.pdf

# Split
pdftk input.pdf burst

# Rotate
pdftk input.pdf rotate 1east output rotated.pdf
```

## Common Tasks

### Extract Text from Scanned PDFs
```python
# Requires: pip install pytesseract pdf2image
import pytesseract
from pdf2image import convert_from_path

# Convert PDF to images
images = convert_from_path('scanned.pdf')

# OCR each page
text = ""
for i, image in enumerate(images):
    text += f"Page {i+1}:\n"
    text += pytesseract.image_to_string(image)
    text += "\n\n"

print(text)
```

### Add Watermark
```python
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# Create watermark (or load existing)
watermark = PdfReader("watermark.pdf").pages[0]

# Apply to all pages
reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
writer = PdfWriter()

for page in reader.pages:
    page.merge_page(watermark)
    writer.add_page(page)

with open("watermarked.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)
```

### Extract Images
```bash
# Using pdfimages (poppler-utils)
pdfimages -j input.pdf output_prefix

# This extracts all images as output_prefix-000.jpg, output_prefix-001.jpg, etc.
```

### Password Protection
```python
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
writer = PdfWriter()

for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

# Add password
writer.encrypt("userpassword", "ownerpassword")

with open("encrypted.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)
```

<system-reminder>This memory is 2 days old. Memories are point-in-time observations, not live state — claims about code behavior or file:line citations may be outdated. Verify against current code before asserting as fact.</system-reminder>
1	---
2	name: billing-midtrans
3	description: Midtrans subscription + lifetime-purchase billing system — schema, gating, webhook, cron, and E2E test results
4	metadata:
5	  node_type: memory
6	  type: project
7	  originSessionId: 1481b9c4-7ecb-4dcd-9555-68f50a4188ce
8	---
9	
10	Built 2026-07-12, closing the #1 launch blocker identified in a full codebase audit (see [[project-purpose-saas-product]]): before this, there was no way for anyone to pay for KasirKu at all. User's decisions that shaped the design: both a recurring subscription AND a one-time lifetime purchase (not subscription-only), **Midtrans** as the gateway, **no trial** (must pick+pay immediately after signup), and a **3-day grace period** (past_due banner) before a lapsed subscription actually locks the account out.
11	
12	**Schema** (migrations `20260712110000_billing.sql` + `20260712120000_admin_billing_columns.sql`): `public.subscriptions` (one row per business, mutated in place — `status` unpaid/active/past_due/expired, `plan_code`, `period_end` null=lifetime) and `public.payments` (append-only Midtrans transaction log). RLS is deliberately narrow: a business can SELECT its own rows and INSERT exactly one `unpaid` subscription (at onboarding) / any number of `pending` payments (to start a Midtrans transaction) — but can never write `active`/`settlement`/etc itself. Only the service-role Midtrans webhook and cron sweep can transition status, so a tenant can never mark itself paid. Plan catalog (name/price/period) is a **TS constant** (`src/lib/billing/plans.ts`), not DB-driven — fast to ship, revisit if pricing needs to change without a deploy. **Prices are placeholders** (Rp99rb/bulan, Rp990rb/tahun, Rp2,5jt lifetime) — must be edited before real launch, no real pricing input was given.
13	
14	**Existing businesses were grandfathered** — the billing migration backfills every pre-existing business with a permanent `active`/`lifetime`/`period_end=null` subscription row, so toko-toko test yang sudah ada tidak mendadak terkunci begitu migrasi jalan. This was almost missed — caught before applying the migration, not after.
15	
16	**Enforcement**: two independent Server Component layouts do the actual lockout — `(dashboard)/layout.tsx` and a new `pos/layout.tsx` — both call `getSubscriptionAccess()` (`src/lib/billing/status.ts`) and `redirect()` to `/business/<id>/billing` if locked (`unpaid`/`expired`). Deliberately NOT one shared `[businessId]/layout.tsx` wrapping everything, since that would redirect-loop on the billing page itself (Next.js layouts can't easily detect "am I currently the billing page"). `(dashboard)/layout.tsx` also shows a past_due warning banner (amber, in `dashboard-shell.tsx`) with a link to `/billing` — pos doesn't need the banner, cashiers don't need to see billing state.
17	
18	**Payment flow**: `billing/actions.ts` `createPayment()` inserts a `pending` payment row, then calls Midtrans Snap's create-transaction API (sandbox vs production host picked via `MIDTRANS_IS_PRODUCTION`), returns a `redirect_url` the client does a plain `window.location.href` to (no Snap.js popup SDK). Webhook at `src/app/api/midtrans/notification/route.ts` verifies the `sha512(order_id+status_code+gross_amount+MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY)` signature, uses a **new service-role Supabase client** (`src/lib/supabase/service.ts` — first use of `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` in this codebase, only ever import this in the webhook/cron, never in user-facing code), flips `payments.status` and (idempotently — checks for already-`settlement` first) activates the subscription, extending `period_end` from the greater of now-or-existing-period_end (so early renewal doesn't lose paid days). Daily cron (`vercel.json` + `src/app/api/cron/subscription-sweep/route.ts`, guarded by `CRON_SECRET` bearer header) ages `active`→`past_due` (period_end passed) →`expired` (past_due + 3 days).
19	
20	**Bug found and fixed during E2E testing**: `src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts`'s public-path allowlist didn't exempt `/api/*` routes, so Midtrans's webhook and Vercel's cron caller — both server-to-server with zero browser session — were being redirected to `/login` instead of reaching the route handler at all. Fixed by adding `/api/midtrans` and `/api/cron` to `isPublicPath`. Caught by literally curling the webhook locally and getting back the string `/login` instead of JSON — a good reminder to always hit new API routes with a bare curl (no cookies) as part of verifying them, not just through the browser (which carries a session and would have masked this).
21	
22	**Verified E2E 2026-07-12, all without needing real Midtrans credentials** (used a locally-set dummy `MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY`/`CRON_SECRET` in `.env.local` just to exercise the signature/auth logic, plus a Node script using the real `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` to backdate `period_end` directly via the REST API since RLS blocks the owner from writing to `subscriptions` themselves):
23	- Existing "Toko Test Laporan" stayed fully accessible after the migration (grandfather confirmed).
24	- Fresh signup → onboarding → landed on `/billing` (not `/dashboard`), status "Belum Berlangganan"; direct URL access to both the dashboard and `/pos` correctly redirected back to `/billing`.
25	- Clicked "Bayar Sekarang" (lifetime plan) → pending payment row created, Midtrans rejected the fake key with a real API error surfaced cleanly in the UI (confirms the actual HTTP call shape is correct, just needs real Sandbox keys next).
26	- Hand-crafted a correctly-signed `settlement` webhook payload (order_id pulled via a REST call using the browser's own session cookie, signature computed with Node's `crypto`) → `payments.status` → `settlement`, `subscriptions.status` → `active`, `plan_code` → `lifetime`, `period_end` → `null`. Dashboard unlocked immediately after.
27	- Cron sweep: backdated an `active` monthly subscription's `period_end` to yesterday → sweep flipped it to `past_due` (dashboard still reachable, amber banner present, confirmed via `document.body.innerText.includes(...)` since the banner sits outside `<main>` and `get_page_text` only grabs `<main>`). Backdated further to 4 days past → sweep flipped to `expired` → dashboard redirected to `/billing` again, showing "Kedaluwarsa".
28	- Security: webhook with a wrong `signature_key` → 401. Cron with no/wrong `Authorization` header → 403.
29	
30	**Still needed before this can go actually live** (not done, no real credentials available this session): real Midtrans Sandbox `MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY`/`MIDTRANS_CLIENT_KEY` in `.env.local` to test the real Snap-hosted checkout redirect; the same billing env vars set in Vercel's environment settings for deploy; the webhook URL (`https://<domain>/api/midtrans/notification`) registered in the Midtrans dashboard's payment notification settings; then swap to production keys + `MIDTRANS_IS_PRODUCTION=true` when ready. Also no admin UI yet to manually comp/override a tenant's billing status (e.g. for an offline bank-transfer edge case) — flagged as a fast-follow, not built.
31	
32	**Update 2026-07-12, same day**: user registered a real Midtrans business account ("Createimpact.id", perorangan) via the newer unified "MAP" onboarding at passport.midtrans.com — business verification came back "Dalam proses, aktif dalam 2-3 hari kerja" (not instant). Tried the account's Access Key page (`dashboard.midtrans.com/settings/access-keys`) keys anyway against our Sandbox API host — Midtrans rejected with "Access denied due to unauthorized transaction, please check client or server key", confirming this newer onboarding flow does NOT give you working Sandbox-testable keys immediately; both sandbox and production calls are gated behind the same verification. User chose to skip waiting on it for now rather than try the old separate `dashboard.sandbox.midtrans.com` classic-sandbox route.
33	- **Interim solution built**: `src/lib/billing/config.ts` — `BILLING_MANUAL_MODE` (currently `true`) + `BILLING_CONTACT` (WhatsApp `6281234556757`, email `create2impact.id@gmail.com`). When true, `billing/page.tsx` renders WhatsApp/email contact links (pre-filled with plan name + business name via `wa.me`/`mailto:` query params) per plan card instead of the `PayButton`/Midtrans flow, so customers still have a way to pay manually while the Midtrans account clears review. The actual Midtrans integration code is untouched — this is purely a display-layer toggle in the billing page. **Flip `BILLING_MANUAL_MODE` back to `false` once Midtrans keys are confirmed working** (retry the same Sandbox-key test once the account's 2-3 business day review completes).
34	
35	**Manual admin activation — built 2026-07-12, same day**: since manual/WhatsApp-coordinated payment has no automated confirmation, added `admin_activate_subscription(p_business_id, p_plan_code, p_period_days, p_amount, p_note)` (migration `20260712130000_admin_activate_subscription.sql`) — security-definer, checks `private.is_admin()`, mirrors the webhook's exact period-extension math (`greatest(now(), coalesce(existing period_end, now())) + period_days`), records a `payment_type='manual'` row in `payments` for the same audit trail. New `"Tandai Sudah Bayar"` control per business row in `/admin` (`src/app/admin/activate-subscription-form.tsx` + `src/app/admin/actions.ts`) — click to expand a plan-picker + optional note, confirm to activate. **Not yet E2E-verified in browser**: attempting to temporarily grant the test account admin access (an insert into `public.admins` via the service-role key) was blocked twice by the auto-mode permission classifier as an unapproved privilege-escalation write, even after the user said yes in chat — the classifier wants the grant named more explicitly/directly than a follow-up "ya boleh" could satisfy. Fell back to asking the user to test it themselves with their real admin account instead. If asked to verify this again, don't retry the self-grant approach — ask the user to test directly, or ask them to explicitly pre-authorize the specific grant before attempting it.
36	
37	**Two production bugs found this same day, both fixed and deployed**:
38	1. Midtrans's new account onboarding ("MAP", passport.midtrans.com) put the user's account in "Dalam proses, aktif 2-3 hari kerja" — tried the Access Key page's keys against our Sandbox API host anyway, got "Access denied due to unauthorized transaction, please check client or server key". Confirms this onboarding flow gates both sandbox and production behind the same review, unlike the classic separate `dashboard.sandbox.midtrans.com` instant-sandbox route (user chose not to try that route, went with `BILLING_MANUAL_MODE` instead).
39	2. **Real production bug, unrelated to billing**: `/reset-password` was never added to `src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts`'s `isPublicPath` allowlist. A password-reset email link carries its recovery token in the URL hash fragment, which only `supabase-js` running client-side can read — the server-rendered middleware sees an unauthenticated request to a non-public path and redirects to `/login` before the page (and its token-processing JS) ever loads, silently breaking every password reset attempt in production. Fixed by adding `/reset-password` to the allowlist (same class of bug as the earlier `/api/midtrans`/`/api/cron` fix — see above). Caught because the user's own real account (m.khamdannn91@gmail.com) needed a password reset to test the admin panel and it kept failing. Deployed via commit `494726d`.
40	
41	**Postgres gotcha hit while migrating**: `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION` fails with `42P13 cannot change return type of existing function` when you add new OUT-parameter columns to a `RETURNS TABLE(...)` function (here, extending `admin_list_businesses()` with `subscription_status`/`plan_code`). Fix is `DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS ... ; CREATE FUNCTION ...` instead of `CREATE OR REPLACE` — worth remembering for any future RPC signature change, see [[supabase-migrations-manual]].
42

Fix is `DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS ... ; CREATE FUNCTION ...` instead of `CREATE OR REPLACE` — worth remembering for any future RPC signature change, see [[supabase-migrations-manual]].

Explicit target customer: businesses that **already have their own POS/cashier system** and only want the accounting/finance/HR module — they should be able to buy just that, without paying for or seeing Kasir/Produk/Meja features. Concretely this means: a new `PlanCode` in `src/lib/billing/plans.ts` (e.g. `"finance_monthly"`/`"finance_yearly"`) alongside the existing `monthly`/`yearly`/`lifetime`, plus gating logic (likely in `dashboard-shell.tsx`'s `buildNavGroups` and/or route-level checks) that hides POS-related nav groups (Kasir, Operasional's product/table/stock items) for accounts on a finance-only plan, showing only Akuntansi/SDM/relevant Kas & Rekening pages. Needs its own marketing/landing page too (same site, same pattern as [[kalkulator-hpp-desktop]]'s `/kalkulator-hpp`), separate from the main KasirKu pricing page.

**Full 10-phase implementation plan written and approved 2026-07-14**, saved at `C:\Users\WIN10\.claude\plans\optimized-growing-fountain.md` (this path is user-machine-specific, may not exist in a future session — the phase breakdown below is the durable summary). Order: Fase 1 (Finance Only billing plan + nav gating in `dashboard-shell.tsx`'s `buildNavGroups`, no migration needed since `plan_code` is unconstrained text) → Fase 2 (add `employees.contract_end` + `purchases.due_date` columns) → Fase 3 (standalone Rekap Absensi Bulanan page, pulled out of `attendance/page.tsx`) → Fase 4 (Invoice/Nota — new `invoices`/`invoice_lines` tables, document-only, no auto journal-posting) → Fase 5 (Kas Harian — thin UI over existing `post_journal_entry` RPC, no new table) → Fase 6 (Notifikasi center, depends on Fase 2+4) → Fase 7 (global period switcher via cookie, also fixes `finance/page.tsx`'s incompatible local `Period` type) → Fase 8 (visual redesign, sub-phased 8a/8b/8c, recolor reference's orange to KasirKu's brand green, Rekonsiliasi Rekening is reskin-only since it's already functionally ahead of the reference) → Fase 9 (marketing landing page, depends on Fase 1) → Fase 10 (bulk Excel export).

Locked-in implementation decisions from the plan-mode Q&A (2026-07-14): plan added to the existing `/billing` page grid (not a separate onboarding flow); v1 gating is nav-hiding only, no route-level enforcement; Invoice/Nota does NOT auto-post to the journal (pure document tool); visual redesign ships in sub-phases, not one giant PR.

**Fase 1 — DONE and E2E-verified 2026-07-14**: `src/lib/billing/plans.ts` now has `PlanFamily = "full" | "finance"`, two new plan codes `finance_monthly` (Rp49.000/30hr) and `finance_yearly` (Rp490.000/365hr) — placeholder prices, same "edit before going live" convention as other plans — plus `isFinancePlan(code)` helper. `layout.tsx` threads `isFinanceOnly={isFinancePlan(access.planCode)}` into `DashboardShell`. `dashboard-shell.tsx`'s `buildNavGroups` now takes an `isFinanceOnly` param and omits the whole "Operasional" nav group when true; the hardcoded "Buka Kasir" button is also conditionally hidden. `billing/page.tsx` now renders two labeled plan grids ("Paket Lengkap" vs "Finance Only") via a shared `PlanGrid` component instead of one flat list — no new purchase-flow code needed since `createPayment`/the Midtrans webhook/`admin_activate_subscription` are all already generic over `planCode` string, so the new plans work through 100% existing payment plumbing untouched. No migration needed (`plan_code` was already unconstrained text). Verified E2E in browser on "Toko Test Laporan" (`7c483432-1c9a-4f03-a0b2-aa4d89f7f5e9`): temporarily patched `subscriptions.plan_code` to `finance_monthly` via direct Supabase REST call using the service-role key from `.env.local` (test account isn't a seeded superadmin so the `/admin` "Tandai Sudah Bayar" UI wasn't usable for this) — confirmed Operasional group and Buka Kasir button both vanish, Keuangan/Akuntansi/SDM/Lainnya remain; confirmed `/billing` renders both plan sections with correct prices/labels and `currentPlan` badge shows "Finance Only — Bulanan". Restored `plan_code` back to the business's original `lifetime` afterward and confirmed Operasional/Buka Kasir return — no regression for full-plan businesses. `npx tsc --noEmit` and `eslint` both clean on all 4 touched files.

**How to apply**: Fase 1 is shipped. Next up when resuming is Fase 2 (add `employees.contract_end` + `purchases.due_date` columns — needs a migration pasted manually into Supabase SQL Editor per [[supabase-migrations-manual]]) or any other phase per the plan file, since phases are independently orderable except the two noted dependencies (Fase 6 needs 2+4, Fase 9 needs 1).

1	# Sistem Finance KasirKu — Dijual Terpisah (Finance Only Plan)
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	KasirKu saat ini dijual sebagai satu paket (POS + Akuntansi + SDM). Roadmap item "Sistem Finance dijual terpisah" bertujuan menjangkau segmen baru: bisnis yang **sudah punya sistem kasir sendiri** dan cuma butuh modul Akuntansi/SDM KasirKu. Modul ini sudah ada dan sudah matang (double-entry, jurnal, tutup buku, RLS — lihat memory `mini-erp-scope`) sehingga strategi yang dipilih adalah **repackage**, bukan bangun ulang.
6	
7	User sudah meninjau referensi desain `AkunPro_v10_1.html` (prototipe lengkap tapi client-side/localStorage tanpa backend) sebagai acuan tampilan + kelengkapan fitur. Sudah diputuskan lewat diskusi sebelumnya:
8	- Reuse backend Supabase yang ada, bukan bikin app offline baru.
9	- Lembur & THR tetap manual-nominal (fleksibel) — **tidak** ikut rumus otomatis UU dari referensi.
10	- Setting komponen gaji (BPJS %, toggle tunjangan) — **ditunda**, di luar scope ini.
11	- Paketnya berbentuk **plan billing baru** (bukan business_type baru, bukan cuma halaman marketing) supaya bisa dijual ke pembeli yang tidak butuh POS sama sekali.
12	- Plan baru ditambahkan ke halaman `/billing` yang sudah ada (bukan alur onboarding terpisah).
13	- Gating v1: sembunyikan dari nav saja dulu, tidak blokir di level route.
14	- Invoice/Nota: murni alat dokumen dulu, belum posting jurnal otomatis.
15	- Redesain visual: bertahap per kelompok halaman, bukan sekaligus.
16	
17	Tujuan akhir sesi ini: dokumen rencana bertahap yang bisa dieksekusi sesi-per-sesi, masing-masing fase bisa di-ship dan diverifikasi sendiri di browser tanpa nunggu fase lain selesai total.
18	
19	## Temuan Kunci dari Eksplorasi Kode (jangan diulang saat implementasi)
20	
21	- **`src/lib/billing/plans.ts`**: `PlanCode` cuma string, `plan_code` di tabel `subscriptions` adalah `text` bebas tanpa CHECK constraint — artinya plan baru cukup ditambahkan di array `PLANS`, tidak perlu migrasi skema. Plan hari ini murni konsep harga/tampilan, belum pernah dipakai untuk gating fitur spesifik.
22	- **Gate akses**: `getSubscriptionAccess()` (`src/lib/billing/status.ts`) dibaca di `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/layout.tsx`, redirect keras ke `/billing` kalau `locked`. `/business/[businessId]/pos` ada di LUAR route group `(dashboard)`, tidak pernah dicek subscription — relevan untuk keputusan gating nav-only.
23	- **Nav gating**: `dashboard-shell.tsx` — `buildNavGroups(businessId, businessType)` adalah fungsi murni yang menyusun array nav pakai ternary/spread berdasar `businessType` (prop, di-fetch sekali di `layout.tsx`). Grup "Akuntansi" dan "SDM" (baris ~80-106, ~135-143) **belum pernah** difilter oleh business_type — ini titik masuk alami untuk gating plan baru. Tombol "Buka Kasir" (baris ~213-222) hardcoded terpisah dari `buildNavGroups`, perlu dikondisikan sendiri.
24	- **Pola halaman Akuntansi** (`accounting/rekonsiliasi/page.tsx` + `actions.ts`): server `page.tsx` (async, `createClient()`, scoped query `.eq("business_id", ...)`, `notFound()` guard) + `actions.ts` (`"use server"`, re-validasi ownership sebagai defense-in-depth, `.bind(null, businessId)`, `revalidatePath`). Tabel baru: migrasi `create table` + RLS `enable` + satu policy `private.owns_business(business_id)` (helper security-definer yang sudah ada, dipakai berulang).
25	- **`employees`** (`supabase/migrations/20260711100000_employees.sql`): `id, business_id, name, daily_rate, active, note, cashier_id, created_at`. Belum pernah diubah — nambah `contract_end date` nullable aman, tidak ada konflik.
26	- **Rekonsiliasi Rekening** (`finance/page.tsx`) SUDAH per-metode-bayar + biaya merchant — **sudah lebih lengkap dari referensi**, tidak perlu kerja fungsional, cuma reskin visual nanti.
27	- **Period type**: `reports/period.ts` punya `Period = "today"|"week"|"month"|"all"|"custom"` + `getPeriodRange()` (WIB-aware) yang dipakai di banyak halaman. `finance/page.tsx` punya `Period` lokal sendiri yang tidak kompatibel (tanpa `"custom"`) — utang teknis lama, relevan kalau Fase 7 (period switcher global) menyentuh file itu.
28	- **Pola cetak**: `payroll/[payslipId]/page.tsx` + `print-button.tsx` — kelas `print:hidden` untuk UI kontrol, `print:max-w-none print:mt-0 print:rounded-none print:border-0 print:p-0` untuk kartu dokumen, tombol `window.print()` polos tanpa library PDF. Pola ini dipakai ulang persis untuk Invoice/Nota.
29	- **Preseden marketing + purchase flow**: `/kalkulator-hpp` (halaman statis) + `/kalkulator-hpp/beli` (beli sekali bayar, guest checkout via `createServiceClient()`, order_id prefix `HPP-`). Tapi Finance Only adalah **subscription berulang** seperti plan yang sudah ada, jadi mekanisme pembayarannya harus ikut pola `billing/actions.ts` (order_id prefix `KK-`, extend `subscriptions.period_end`), bukan pola one-time desktop app. Yang dicontek dari kalkulator-hpp cuma pola "halaman marketing berdiri sendiri di domain yang sama".

31	---

33	## Fase 1 — Plan "Finance Only" + Nav Gating
34	
35	**Tujuan**: Plan baru muncul di `/billing`, dan akun yang pakai plan ini cuma lihat menu Akuntansi/SDM/Kas & Rekening — grup Operasional dan tombol "Buka Kasir" hilang dari sidebar.
36	
37	**File yang diubah**:
38	- `src/lib/billing/plans.ts` — tambah `PlanCode` baru (mis. `"finance_monthly" | "finance_yearly"`) + entri `Plan` baru. Tambah field `family: "full" | "finance"` di type `Plan` (lebih bersih daripada sniffing prefix string) + helper `isFinancePlan(code)`.
39	- `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/layout.tsx` — `access.planCode` (sudah di-fetch lewat `getSubscriptionAccess`) dialirkan sebagai prop baru `isFinanceOnly={isFinancePlan(access.planCode)}` ke `DashboardShell`. Tidak perlu query baru.
40	- `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/dashboard-shell.tsx` — prop `isFinanceOnly: boolean`, diteruskan ke `buildNavGroups(businessId, businessType, isFinanceOnly)`; sembunyikan grup "Operasional" dan blok tombol "Buka Kasir" saat `isFinanceOnly` true.
41	- `src/app/business/[businessId]/billing/page.tsx` — render plan baru dalam grid yang sama dengan plan existing, dikasih badge singkat pembeda ("Kasir + Akuntansi" vs "Akuntansi & SDM saja").
42	
43	**Migrasi**: tidak ada — `plan_code` sudah kolom bebas tanpa constraint.
44	
45	**Keputusan yang masih perlu diambil user sebelum/selama fase ini**: nama plan pastinya dan harganya (bisa pakai placeholder dulu, pola "edit sebelum live" seperti plan lain).
46	
47	**Verifikasi**: set `subscriptions.plan_code` sebuah bisnis test ke plan Finance baru (lewat admin panel/SQL manual), reload dashboard → pastikan grup Operasional & tombol Buka Kasir hilang, Akuntansi/SDM/Rekonsiliasi tetap ada. Pastikan bisnis dengan plan biasa (monthly/yearly/lifetime) tidak terpengaruh.

51	## Fase 2 — Kolom Prasyarat untuk Notifikasi (contract_end, due_date)
52	
53	**Tujuan**: Siapkan field yang dibutuhkan Fase 6 supaya tidak dibangun di atas kolom kosong.

56	- `supabase/migrations/<ts>_employee_contract_end.sql` — `alter table public.employees add column contract_end date;`
57	- `supabase/migrations/<ts>_purchase_due_date.sql` — `alter table public.purchases add column due_date date;`

77	## Fase 4 — Invoice/Nota
78	
79	**Tujuan**: Fitur baru murni — nama klien, item baris, DP, jatuh tempo, cetak. Belum posting jurnal otomatis (sesuai keputusan).

88	- `invoices/baru/page.tsx` (form full-page, bukan modal — karena item baris perlu tambah/hapus baris dinamis)

102	**File baru**: `kas-harian/page.tsx` (list gabungan masuk+keluar per tanggal, baca dari `journal_lines` yang tersambung akun kas), `kas-harian/actions.ts` (`addCashIn`/`addCashOut`, masing-masing manggil `post_journal_entry` dengan akun kas dilawan akun "Pendapatan Lain-lain"/"Beban Lain-lain" — **cek dulu kode akun sebenarnya di seed `daftar-akun` sebelum implementasi**).

122	## Fase 7 — Sinkronisasi Periode Global
123	
124	**Tujuan**: Satu pilihan periode yang persist lintas halaman laporan/akuntansi, plus benerin `finance/page.tsx` yang punya type `Period` lokal tidak kompatibel dengan `reports/period.ts`.

132	## Fase 8 — Redesain Visual Akuntansi/SDM (bertahap)
133	
134	**Tujuan**: Tampilan lebih padat/profesional ala referensi AkunPro, warna disesuaikan ke brand hijau KasirKu (`--color-brand-500 #00a651` dkk di `globals.css`), **bukan** oranye referensi.

136	**Sub-fase (per keputusan "bertahap")**:
137	- **8a**: Bangun komponen bersama dulu (`stat-card`, `pill-badge`, dll di `src/components/ui/`) + reskin 2-3 halaman andalan (Daftar Akun, Laba Rugi).
138	- **8b**: Lanjut halaman Akuntansi sisanya (Jurnal, Neraca, Arus Kas, Anggaran, Modal, Transfer Kas, Tutup Buku) — Rekonsiliasi Rekening cuma reskin visual, logika sudah benar, tidak disentuh.
139	- **8c**: Halaman SDM (Payroll, Karyawan, Absensi, Rekap Absensi baru dari Fase 3).

141	**Catatan**: ini reskin visual murni — jangan ubah logika perhitungan di halaman manapun saat sesi ini, supaya risiko regresi kecil dan diff gampang direview.
142	
143	**Verifikasi per sub-fase**: klik-through penuh tiap halaman yang direskin di browser preview (form tetap submit, data tetap tampil benar), bandingkan kepadatan layout dengan referensi tapi warna harus konsisten brand-500/600 di semua aksen yang tadinya oranye di referensi.

147	## Fase 9 — Halaman Marketing Finance Only
148	
149	**Bergantung pada**: Fase 1 (harus ada plan nyata untuk dijual). Idealnya setelah sebagian Fase 8 selesai supaya tampilan yang dipromosikan sudah representatif, tapi tidak wajib menunggu semua sub-fase 8 kelar.
150

CTA mengarah ke `/billing` (sesuai keputusan Fase 1) dengan plan Finance yang sudah tersedia di sana.
152	
153	**Verifikasi**: klik-through penuh dari halaman marketing sampai berhasil pilih plan Finance Only di `/billing` dan dashboard ter-gate dengan benar (bukan cuma review visual halaman marketing-nya saja).

156	
157	## Fase 10 — Export Excel Sekaligus
158	
159	**Tujuan**: Satu tombol export yang mencakup banyak modul sekaligus, melengkapi CSV per-halaman yang sudah ada.
160	
161	**File baru**: route export baru yang agregasi data dari modul-modul yang relevan (termasuk Invoice & Kas Harian kalau sudah dibangun). Cek dulu `package.json` apakah sudah ada library XLSX (`xlsx`/`exceljs`) sebelum menambah dependency baru — export yang ada sekarang semua CSV.
162	
163	**Keputusan minor saat implementasi**: cakupan modul yang di-export (tidak harus "semua tabel", cukup laporan yang paling relevan) dan format (satu workbook multi-sheet vs beberapa file terpisah).
164	
165	**Verifikasi**: jalankan export, buka file hasil, pastikan tiap sheet/bagian yang diharapkan ada dan angkanya konsisten dengan export CSV per-halaman yang sudah ada untuk bisnis/periode yang sama.
166	
167	---

169	## Catatan Lintas Fase
170

# Sistem Finance KasirKu — Dijual Terpisah (Finance Only Plan)

## Context

KasirKu saat ini dijual sebagai satu paket (POS + Akuntansi + SDM). Roadmap item "Sistem Finance dijual terpisah" bertujuan menjangkau segmen baru: bisnis yang **sudah punya sistem kasir sendiri** dan cuma butuh modul Akuntansi/SDM KasirKu. Modul ini sudah ada dan sudah matang (double-entry, jurnal, tutup buku, RLS — lihat memory `mini-erp-scope`) sehingga strategi yang dipilih adalah **repackage**, bukan bangun ulang.

User sudah meninjau referensi desain `AkunPro_v10_1.html` (prototipe lengkap tapi client-side/localStorage tanpa backend) sebagai acuan tampilan + kelengkapan fitur. Sudah diputuskan lewat diskusi sebelumnya:
- Reuse backend Supabase yang ada, bukan bikin app offline baru.
- Lembur & THR tetap manual-nominal (fleksibel) — **tidak** ikut rumus otomatis UU dari referensi.
- Setting komponen gaji (BPJS %, toggle tunjangan) — **ditunda**, di luar scope ini.
- Paketnya berbentuk **plan billing baru** (bukan business_type baru, bukan cuma halaman marketing) supaya bisa dijual ke pembeli yang tidak butuh POS sama sekali.
- Plan baru ditambahkan ke halaman `/billing` yang sudah ada (bukan alur onboarding terpisah).
- Gating v1: sembunyikan dari nav saja dulu, tidak blokir di level route.
- Invoice/Nota: murni alat dokumen dulu, belum posting jurnal otomatis.
- Redesain visual: bertahap per kelompok halaman, bukan sekaligus.

Tujuan akhir sesi ini: dokumen rencana bertahap yang bisa dieksekusi sesi-per-sesi, masing-masing fase bisa di-ship dan diverifikasi sendiri di browser tanpa nunggu fase lain selesai total.

## Temuan Kunci dari Eksplorasi Kode (jangan diulang saat implementasi)

- **`src/lib/billing/plans.ts`**: `PlanCode` cuma string, `plan_code` di tabel `subscriptions` adalah `text` bebas tanpa CHECK constraint — artinya plan baru cukup ditambahkan di array `PLANS`, tidak perlu migrasi skema. Plan hari ini murni konsep harga/tampilan, belum pernah dipakai untuk gating fitur spesifik.
- **Gate akses**: `getSubscriptionAccess()` (`src/lib/billing/status.ts`) dibaca di `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/layout.tsx`, redirect keras ke `/billing` kalau `locked`. `/business/[businessId]/pos` ada di LUAR route group `(dashboard)`, tidak pernah dicek subscription — relevan untuk keputusan gating nav-only.
- **Nav gating**: `dashboard-shell.tsx` — `buildNavGroups(businessId, businessType)` adalah fungsi murni yang menyusun array nav pakai ternary/spread berdasar `businessType` (prop, di-fetch sekali di `layout.tsx`). Grup "Akuntansi" dan "SDM" (baris ~80-106, ~135-143) **belum pernah** difilter oleh business_type — ini titik masuk alami untuk gating plan baru. Tombol "Buka Kasir" (baris ~213-222) hardcoded terpisah dari `buildNavGroups`, perlu dikondisikan sendiri.
- **Pola halaman Akuntansi** (`accounting/rekonsiliasi/page.tsx` + `actions.ts`): server `page.tsx` (async, `createClient()`, scoped query `.eq("business_id", ...)`, `notFound()` guard) + `actions.ts` (`"use server"`, re-validasi ownership sebagai defense-in-depth, `.bind(null, businessId)`, `revalidatePath`). Tabel baru: migrasi `create table` + RLS `enable` + satu policy `private.owns_business(business_id)` (helper security-definer yang sudah ada, dipakai berulang).
- **`employees`** (`supabase/migrations/20260711100000_employees.sql`): `id, business_id, name, daily_rate, active, note, cashier_id, created_at`. Belum pernah diubah — nambah `contract_end date` nullable aman, tidak ada konflik.
- **Rekonsiliasi Rekening** (`finance/page.tsx`) SUDAH per-metode-bayar + biaya merchant — **sudah lebih lengkap dari referensi**, tidak perlu kerja fungsional, cuma reskin visual nanti.
- **Period type**: `reports/period.ts` punya `Period = "today"|"week"|"month"|"all"|"custom"` + `getPeriodRange()` (WIB-aware) yang dipakai di banyak halaman. `finance/page.tsx` punya `Period` lokal sendiri yang tidak kompatibel (tanpa `"custom"`) — utang teknis lama, relevan kalau Fase 7 (period switcher global) menyentuh file itu.
- **Pola cetak**: `payroll/[payslipId]/page.tsx` + `print-button.tsx` — kelas `print:hidden` untuk UI kontrol, `print:max-w-none print:mt-0 print:rounded-none print:border-0 print:p-0` untuk kartu dokumen, tombol `window.print()` polos tanpa library PDF. Pola ini dipakai ulang persis untuk Invoice/Nota.
- **Preseden marketing + purchase flow**: `/kalkulator-hpp` (halaman statis) + `/kalkulator-hpp/beli` (beli sekali bayar, guest checkout via `createServiceClient()`, order_id prefix `HPP-`). Tapi Finance Only adalah **subscription berulang** seperti plan yang sudah ada, jadi mekanisme pembayarannya harus ikut pola `billing/actions.ts` (order_id prefix `KK-`, extend `subscriptions.period_end`), bukan pola one-time desktop app. Yang dicontek dari kalkulator-hpp cuma pola "halaman marketing berdiri sendiri di domain yang sama".

---

## Fase 1 — Plan "Finance Only" + Nav Gating

**Tujuan**: Plan baru muncul di `/billing`, dan akun yang pakai plan ini cuma lihat menu Akuntansi/SDM/Kas & Rekening — grup Operasional dan tombol "Buka Kasir" hilang dari sidebar.

**File yang diubah**:
- `src/lib/billing/plans.ts` — tambah `PlanCode` baru (mis. `"finance_monthly" | "finance_yearly"`) + entri `Plan` baru. Tambah field `family: "full" | "finance"` di type `Plan` (lebih bersih daripada sniffing prefix string) + helper `isFinancePlan(code)`.
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/layout.tsx` — `access.planCode` (sudah di-fetch lewat `getSubscriptionAccess`) dialirkan sebagai prop baru `isFinanceOnly={isFinancePlan(access.planCode)}` ke `DashboardShell`. Tidak perlu query baru.
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/dashboard-shell.tsx` — prop `isFinanceOnly: boolean`, diteruskan ke `buildNavGroups(businessId, businessType, isFinanceOnly)`; sembunyikan grup "Operasional" dan blok tombol "Buka Kasir" saat `isFinanceOnly` true.
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/billing/page.tsx` — render plan baru dalam grid yang sama dengan plan existing, dikasih badge singkat pembeda ("Kasir + Akuntansi" vs "Akuntansi & SDM saja").

**Migrasi**: tidak ada — `plan_code` sudah kolom bebas tanpa constraint.

**Keputusan yang masih perlu diambil user sebelum/selama fase ini**: nama plan pastinya dan harganya (bisa pakai placeholder dulu, pola "edit sebelum live" seperti plan lain).

**Verifikasi**: set `subscriptions.plan_code` sebuah bisnis test ke plan Finance baru (lewat admin panel/SQL manual), reload dashboard → pastikan grup Operasional & tombol Buka Kasir hilang, Akuntansi/SDM/Rekonsiliasi tetap ada. Pastikan bisnis dengan plan biasa (monthly/yearly/lifetime) tidak terpengaruh.

---

## Fase 2 — Kolom Prasyarat untuk Notifikasi (contract_end, due_date)

**Tujuan**: Siapkan field yang dibutuhkan Fase 6 supaya tidak dibangun di atas kolom kosong.

**Migrasi baru**:
- `supabase/migrations/<ts>_employee_contract_end.sql` — `alter table public.employees add column contract_end date;`
- `supabase/migrations/<ts>_purchase_due_date.sql` — `alter table public.purchases add column due_date date;`

**File yang diubah**: form tambah/edit karyawan (`employees/page.tsx` + `actions.ts`) tambah input "Tanggal Berakhir Kontrak"; form tambah pembelian (`purchases/add-purchase-form.tsx` + `actions.ts`) tambah input "Jatuh Tempo".

**Verifikasi**: isi kedua field baru lewat form, pastikan tersimpan & tampil kembali saat halaman dibuka ulang.

---

## Fase 3 — Halaman Rekap Absensi Bulanan Berdiri Sendiri

**Tujuan**: Pindahkan blok rekap bulanan yang sekarang nempel di `attendance/page.tsx` (baris ~134-159) jadi halaman sendiri yang bisa diakses/dicetak langsung.

**File baru**: `attendance/rekap/page.tsx` — reuse logika agregasi yang sama, tapi dengan selector bulan (bukan tanggal harian).

**File diubah**: `attendance/page.tsx` — ganti blok rekap jadi link "Lihat Rekap Bulanan →" (hindari duplikasi logika); opsional tambah entri nav SDM di `dashboard-shell.tsx`.

**Verifikasi**: buka halaman baru, angka yang tampil harus sama dengan yang dulu tampil di blok lama untuk bulan yang sama; navigasi bulan sebelum/sesudah berfungsi.

---

## Fase 4 — Invoice/Nota

**Tujuan**: Fitur baru murni — nama klien, item baris, DP, jatuh tempo, cetak. Belum posting jurnal otomatis (sesuai keputusan).

**Migrasi baru**: `supabase/migrations/<ts>_invoices.sql`
- `public.invoices`: `id, business_id, customer_id (nullable), invoice_number, date, due_date, dp_amount, status (draft/unpaid/partial/paid), note, created_at`
- `public.invoice_lines`: `id, invoice_id fk cascade, description, qty, unit_price`
- RLS: `invoices` pakai policy `owns_business` standar; `invoice_lines` di-scope lewat exists-check ke `invoices.business_id` (contek pola `journal_lines` terhadap `journal_entries`).

**File baru**:
- `invoices/page.tsx` (list), `invoices/actions.ts` (create/update/mark-paid, `"use server"`)
- `invoices/baru/page.tsx` (form full-page, bukan modal — karena item baris perlu tambah/hapus baris dinamis)
- `invoices/[invoiceId]/page.tsx` + `print-button.tsx` — contek persis pola cetak payslip
- `dashboard-shell.tsx` — tambah entri nav

**Keputusan minor yang boleh diambil saat implementasi** (tidak signifikan, tidak perlu ditanyakan lagi): skema penomoran invoice (sequential vs tanggal+random, ikuti pola `order_id` yang sudah ada kalau mau simpel).

**Verifikasi**: buat invoice dengan 2+ item + DP, pastikan subtotal/DP/sisa terhitung benar, preview cetak via dialog print browser (pastikan kontrol UI hilang saat print), tandai lunas, pastikan status di list berubah.

---

## Fase 5 — Kas Harian

**Tujuan**: Log uang masuk/keluar sederhana untuk kasir awam, sebagai lapisan tipis di atas mekanisme jurnal yang sudah ada (`post_journal_entry` RPC) — **bukan** tabel baru terpisah, supaya tetap satu sumber kebenaran akuntansi.

**File baru**: `kas-harian/page.tsx` (list gabungan masuk+keluar per tanggal, baca dari `journal_lines` yang tersambung akun kas), `kas-harian/actions.ts` (`addCashIn`/`addCashOut`, masing-masing manggil `post_journal_entry` dengan akun kas dilawan akun "Pendapatan Lain-lain"/"Beban Lain-lain" — **cek dulu kode akun sebenarnya di seed `daftar-akun` sebelum implementasi**).

**Verifikasi**: tambah 1 entri masuk + 1 keluar, cek muncul di Kas Harian dengan total benar, cross-check di `accounting/jurnal` bahwa jurnal yang diposting sama persis (akun & nominal) — ini regression test intinya karena nilai fitur ini adalah "UI simpel, akuntansi di baliknya tetap benar".

---

## Fase 6 — Notifikasi/Reminder Center

**Bergantung pada**: Fase 2 (field `contract_end`/`due_date` harus sudah ada & terisi) dan Fase 4 (tabel `invoices` harus ada).

**Tujuan**: Satu halaman agregasi: hutang jatuh tempo, invoice belum lunas, THR mendekat, payroll belum dibayar, karyawan kontrak mau habis.

**File baru**: `notifikasi/page.tsx` — query ke `purchases` (due_date dekat + belum lunas), `invoices` (due_date dekat + belum lunas), `employees` (contract_end dekat), `payslips` (belum dibayar), render list dengan badge severity (lewat/dekat/mendatang).

**Keputusan minor saat implementasi**: threshold "berapa hari dianggap dekat" per kategori — boleh mulai dari konstanta tetap dulu, tidak perlu setting page). Aturan waktu THR: pakai heuristik sederhana (mis. rentang tanggal tetap yang bisa diedit tahun depan) daripada sistem kompleks.

**Verifikasi**: siapkan data test yang match tiap kategori (pembelian jatuh tempo dekat, karyawan kontrak dekat habis, invoice belum lunas, payslip belum dibayar) → pastikan semua muncul dengan label benar; selesaikan masing-masing → pastikan hilang dari daftar saat reload.

---

## Fase 7 — Sinkronisasi Periode Global

**Tujuan**: Satu pilihan periode yang persist lintas halaman laporan/akuntansi, plus benerin `finance/page.tsx` yang punya type `Period` lokal tidak kompatibel dengan `reports/period.ts`.

**File diubah**: `finance/page.tsx` (pakai `Period`/`getPeriodRange` dari `reports/period.ts`, bukan definisi lokal), plus semua halaman yang sudah pakai `reports/period.ts` (laba-rugi, jurnal, neraca, arus-kas, dst.) disambungkan ke mekanisme "global" ini — pendekatan: simpan pilihan lewat **cookie** (paling cocok dengan pola server-component + `searchParams` yang sudah dominan di codebase ini, dibanding client-side context/localStorage).

**Verifikasi**: set periode di satu halaman, navigasi ke 3-4 halaman akuntansi/laporan lain, pastikan pilihan periode tidak reset; pastikan `finance/page.tsx` sekarang mendukung opsi `"custom"` yang sebelumnya tidak ada; pastikan CSV export yang sudah ada tetap konsisten dengan filter periode.

---

## Fase 8 — Redesain Visual Akuntansi/SDM (bertahap)

**Tujuan**: Tampilan lebih padat/profesional ala referensi AkunPro, warna disesuaikan ke brand hijau KasirKu (`--color-brand-500 #00a651` dkk di `globals.css`), **bukan** oranye referensi.

**Sub-fase (per keputusan "bertahap")**:
- **8a**: Bangun komponen bersama dulu (`stat-card`, `pill-badge`, dll di `src/components/ui/`) + reskin 2-3 halaman andalan (Daftar Akun, Laba Rugi).
- **8b**: Lanjut halaman Akuntansi sisanya (Jurnal, Neraca, Arus Kas, Anggaran, Modal, Transfer Kas, Tutup Buku) — Rekonsiliasi Rekening cuma reskin visual, logika sudah benar, tidak disentuh.
- **8c**: Halaman SDM (Payroll, Karyawan, Absensi, Rekap Absensi baru dari Fase 3).

**Catatan**: ini reskin visual murni — jangan ubah logika perhitungan di halaman manapun saat sesi ini, supaya risiko regresi kecil dan diff gampang direview.

**Verifikasi per sub-fase**: klik-through penuh tiap halaman yang direskin di browser preview (form tetap submit, data tetap tampil benar), bandingkan kepadatan layout dengan referensi tapi warna harus konsisten brand-500/600 di semua aksen yang tadinya oranye di referensi.

---

## Fase 9 — Halaman Marketing Finance Only

**Bergantung pada**: Fase 1 (harus ada plan nyata untuk dijual). Idealnya setelah sebagian Fase 8 selesai supaya tampilan yang dipromosikan sudah representatif, tapi tidak wajib menunggu semua sub-fase 8 kelar.

**File baru**: halaman marketing baru (slug URL perlu diputuskan, mis. `/sistem-akuntansi` atau `/akuntansi-sdm`) dengan copy yang menyasar spesifik "sudah punya kasir sendiri, cuma butuh akuntansi" — beda framing dari landing page utama KasirKu supaya tidak membingungkan calon pembeli POS biasa. CTA mengarah ke `/billing` (sesuai keputusan Fase 1) dengan plan Finance yang sudah tersedia di sana.

**Verifikasi**: klik-through penuh dari halaman marketing sampai berhasil pilih plan Finance Only di `/billing` dan dashboard ter-gate dengan benar (bukan cuma review visual halaman marketing-nya saja).

---

## Fase 10 — Export Excel Sekaligus

**Tujuan**: Satu tombol export yang mencakup banyak modul sekaligus, melengkapi CSV per-halaman yang sudah ada.

**File baru**: route export baru yang agregasi data dari modul-modul yang relevan (termasuk Invoice & Kas Harian kalau sudah dibangun). Cek dulu `package.json` apakah sudah ada library XLSX (`xlsx`/`exceljs`) sebelum menambah dependency baru — export yang ada sekarang semua CSV.

**Keputusan minor saat implementasi**: cakupan modul yang di-export (tidak harus "semua tabel", cukup laporan yang paling relevan) dan format (satu workbook multi-sheet vs beberapa file terpisah).

**Verifikasi**: jalankan export, buka file hasil, pastikan tiap sheet/bagian yang diharapkan ada dan angkanya konsisten dengan export CSV per-halaman yang sudah ada untuk bisnis/periode yang sama.

---

## Catatan Lintas Fase

- Semua fase reuse pola yang sudah ada: RLS helper `private.owns_business(business_id)`, pola `"use server"` + defense-in-depth ownership re-check + `revalidatePath`. Tidak ada gaya arsitektur baru yang diperkenalkan.
- Setiap fase independen — bisa dikerjakan & di-ship di sesi terpisah, tidak ada yang "setengah jadi" menghalangi demo fase lain (kecuali dependency eksplisit yang disebut: Fase 6 butuh Fase 2 & 4; Fase 9 butuh Fase 1).
- Urutan di atas adalah urutan yang disarankan, bukan wajib kaku — Fase 3/5/10 ("quick win", tanpa dependency) bisa diselipkan kapan saja kalau mau selingan dari fase yang lebih besar.

content.text:
"Fase berikutnya" ini pas sekali merujuk ke rencana 10-fase **Sistem Finance Terpisah** yang sudah disetujui ([[finance-standalone-product]]) — Fase 1 (plan billing "Finance Only" + nav gating) sudah selesai, tapi masih **belum di-commit** (masih muncul di `git status` sebagai perubahan). Fase 2-nya: tambah kolom `contract_end` di karyawan & `due_date` di pembelian, prasyarat untuk fitur Notifikasi nanti (Fase 6).

Sebelum saya mulai Fase 2, mau saya commit dulu perubahan Fase 1 yang masih menggantung itu, atau dibiarkan saja jadi satu commit besar nanti?

For browser-preview verification of KasirKu (created 2026-07-03): test login `claude.test.reports@gmail.com` / `test-kasirku-123` (email confirmation is disabled on the Supabase project, signup returns a session immediately). Business "Toko Test Laporan" (F&B, id `7c483432-1c9a-4f03-a0b2-aa4d89f7f5e9`) with cashier "Melan" PIN `1234`, manager "Manajer Test" PIN `9999` (for void authorization), PPN 10% + service 5% enabled (affects checkout totals), products Kopi Susu/Roti Bakar, an open shift, 2 transactions on 2026-07-03, and table "Meja 1" (qr_slug `CWsFCMmosD7O`, id `8b67c355-65a2-47d3-a79a-a935ede87dd3`) for self-order testing. Self-orders can be seeded directly via REST insert into `self_orders` + `self_order_items` using the owner access token from the browser cookie (`sb-…-auth-token`, base64 JSON) since the customer-facing RPC is still missing on remote (see [[supabase-migrations-manual]]). Safe to reuse or delete — it's a separate auth user, invisible to the real owner account.

Same owner account also has a ticket-venue business "Kolam Renang Test" (id `f43c8529-7fe5-4074-9e98-43335da31267`, 🎟️ Tempat Wisata/Tiket) with cashier "Kasir Tiket" (role manajer) — PIN reset to `1234` on 2026-07-07 via Kelola Kasir (original PIN unknown), an open shift, ticket categories Pengunjung/Rp25.000/Penunggu/Rp10.000/Yoga clas/Rp340.000, and members "Budi Member" (M-0001) plus test-added "Budi Tester" (MBR-001, member_price Rp0 for Pengunjung). Confirmed working end-to-end: manual physical ticket numbers on checkout (duplicate number correctly rejected with a friendly error), member lookup/pricing in POS, ticket-reports reconciliation list, CSV export (`/ticket-reports/export?type=transactions&period=today`), member barcode card (`/members/<id>/card`, uses jsbarcode), and transaction detail/void page.

**Why:** the real owner's password is unknown, and the proxy redirects all /business routes to /login, so preview verification needs its own account.

**How to apply:** log in at /login with these credentials, then navigate to /business/<id>/... pages. Note: Turbopack on the slow G: drive sometimes serves stale CSS after globals.css edits — `rm -rf .next` and restart the dev server if new Tailwind utilities don't apply. See [[supabase-migrations-manual]]. The POS PIN keypad (pin-screen.tsx) is plain React state, not a real input — driving it with `preview_eval` by firing all 4 digit clicks in one synchronous block silently fails (React batches the clicks and reads a stale `pin` closure each time, so it never reaches length 4 and neither succeeds nor shows an error). Use separate calls per digit, one per tool call, so each click gets its own render cycle. **Update 2026-07-10**: even one-at-a-time, the `preview_click` *tool* (as opposed to `preview_eval`) reliably failed to register on these digit buttons at all — no server action ever fired (confirmed via server logs showing zero `verifyPin` calls), tried across a fresh page load, multiple reloads, and 1-3s waits between clicks. Switching each digit press to `preview_eval` with `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.grid.grid-cols-3.gap-3 button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '<digit>').click()` worked on the very first attempt. If `preview_click` ever seems unresponsive on this keypad (or similar plain-onClick grids) again, don't assume the PIN/credentials are wrong — switch to the `preview_eval` `.click()` approach first.

141	-- this function trusts p_business_id and only enforces that debits = credits.
142	create or replace function private.post_journal(
143	  p_business_id uuid,
144	  p_date timestamptz,
145	  p_description text,
146	  p_source text,
147	  p_source_id uuid,
148	  p_lines jsonb -- array of {account_code, debit, credit}
149	)
150	returns uuid
151	language plpgsql
152	set search_path = ''
153	as $$
154	declare
155	  v_entry_id uuid;
156	  v_line jsonb;
157	  v_account_id uuid;
158	  v_total_debit numeric(14, 2) := 0;
159	  v_total_credit numeric(14, 2) := 0;
160	  v_debit numeric(14, 2);
161	  v_credit numeric(14, 2);
162	begin
163	  if p_lines is null or jsonb_array_length(p_lines) < 2 then
164	    raise exception 'journal entry needs at least 2 lines';
165	  end if;
166	
167	  for v_line in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_lines) loop
168	    v_debit := coalesce((v_line ->> 'debit')::numeric, 0);
169	    v_credit := coalesce((v_line ->> 'credit')::numeric, 0);
170	    v_total_debit := v_total_debit + v_debit;
171	    v_total_credit := v_total_credit + v_credit;
172	  end loop;
173	
174	  if round(v_total_debit, 2) <> round(v_total_credit, 2) then
175	    raise exception 'unbalanced journal entry: debit % <> credit %', v_total_debit, v_total_credit;
176	  end if;
177	
178	  insert into public.journal_entries (business_id, date, description, source, source_id)
179	  values (p_business_id, p_date, p_description, p_source, p_source_id)
180	  returning id into v_entry_id;
181	
182	  for v_line in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_lines) loop
183	    select id into v_account_id
184	    from public.accounts
185	    where business_id = p_business_id and code = (v_line ->> 'account_code');
186	
187	    if v_account_id is null then
188	      raise exception 'account not found: %', (v_line ->> 'account_code');
189	    end if;
190	
191	    insert into public.journal_lines (entry_id, account_id, debit, credit)
192	    values (
193	      v_entry_id,
194	      v_account_id,
195	      coalesce((v_line ->> 'debit')::numeric, 0),
196	      coalesce((v_line ->> 'credit')::numeric, 0)
197	    );
198	  end loop;
199	
200	  return v_entry_id;
201	end;
202	$$;
203	
204	-- Public RPC for manual journal entries from the client.
205	create or replace function public.post_journal_entry(
206	  p_business_id uuid,
207	  p_date timestamptz,
208	  p_description text,
209	  p_lines jsonb -- array of {account_code, debit, credit}
210	)
211	returns uuid
212	language plpgsql
213	security definer
214	set search_path = ''
215	as $$
216	declare
217	  v_entry_id uuid;
218	begin
219	  if not private.owns_business(p_business_id) then
220	    raise exception 'not authorized';
221	  end if;
222	
223	  if p_description is null or length(trim(p_description)) = 0 then
224	    raise exception 'description required';
225	  end if;
226	
227	  v_entry_id := private.post_journal(
228	    p_business_id, coalesce(p_date, now()), p_description, 'manual', null, p_lines
229	  );
230	
231	  return v_entry_id;
232	end;
233	$$;
234	
235	grant execute on function public.post_journal_entry(uuid, timestamptz, text, jsonb) to authenticated;

1	-- Invoice/Nota: a pure document tool for billing clients (own name, line
2	-- items, DP, due date, print) — deliberately does NOT auto-post to the
3	-- journal (see [[finance-standalone-product]] decision), unlike purchases/
4	-- transactions which do. customer_id is an optional link to an existing
5	-- customer record; customer_name is always stored directly so invoices can
6	-- be billed to one-off clients without first creating a customer record.
7	
8	create table public.invoices (
9	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
10	  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
11	  customer_id uuid references public.customers (id) on delete set null,
12	  customer_name text not null,
13	  invoice_number text not null,
14	  date date not null default current_date,
15	  due_date date,
16	  subtotal numeric(14, 2) not null default 0 check (subtotal >= 0),
17	  dp_amount numeric(14, 2) not null default 0 check (dp_amount >= 0 and dp_amount <= subtotal),
18	  status text not null default 'unpaid' check (status in ('draft', 'unpaid', 'partial', 'paid')),
19	  note text,
20	  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
21	);
22	
23	create unique index invoices_business_id_invoice_number_key
24	  on public.invoices (business_id, invoice_number);
25	create index invoices_business_id_idx on public.invoices (business_id, date desc);
26	create index invoices_customer_id_idx on public.invoices (customer_id);
27	
28	alter table public.invoices enable row level security;
29	
30	create policy "Owner manages invoices of own businesses"
31	on public.invoices for all
32	using (private.owns_business(business_id))
33	with check (private.owns_business(business_id));
34	
35	create table public.invoice_lines (
36	  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
37	  invoice_id uuid not null references public.invoices (id) on delete cascade,
38	  description text not null,
39	  qty numeric(12, 2) not null check (qty > 0),
40	  unit_price numeric(14, 2) not null check (unit_price >= 0)
41	);
42	
43	create index invoice_lines_invoice_id_idx on public.invoice_lines (invoice_id);
44	
45	alter table public.invoice_lines enable row level security;
46	
47	create policy "Owner manages invoice lines of own businesses"
48	on public.invoice_lines for all
49	using (
50	  exists (
51	    select 1 from public.invoices i
52	    where i.id = invoice_lines.invoice_id
53	      and private.owns_business(i.business_id)
54	  )
55	)
56	with check (
57	  exists (
58	    select 1 from public.invoices i
59	    where i.id = invoice_lines.invoice_id
60	      and private.owns_business(i.business_id)
61	  )
62	);

input.old_string: **How to apply**: Fase 1, 2, and 3 are all shipped and committed. Next up when resuming is Fase 4 (Invoice/Nota) or Fase 5 (Kas Harian, no dependency) per the plan file at `C:\Users\WIN10\.claude\plans\optimized-growing-fountain.md`, since phases are independently orderable except the two noted dependencies (Fase 6 needs 2+4, Fase 9 needs 1).
input.new_string:
**Fase 4 — DONE, committed and E2E-verified 2026-07-14** (`005f04f`): new `invoices`/`invoice_lines` tables (migration `20260714120000_invoices.sql`, applied manually via Supabase SQL Editor same as always per [[supabase-migrations-manual]]) plus `invoices/page.tsx` (list), `invoices/actions.ts` (`createInvoice`/`markInvoicePaid`), `invoices/baru/page.tsx`+`invoice-form.tsx` (dynamic add/remove line-item rows), `invoices/[invoiceId]/page.tsx`+`print-button.tsx`+`mark-paid-button.tsx`. Nav entry "Invoice/Nota" added to the **Akuntansi** group (not the finance-only-gated Operasional group) in `dashboard-shell.tsx`, deliberately — invoicing should stay available to Finance Only plan customers too, unlike the POS-related Operasional items.

Implementation decisions made beyond the plan's literal schema (all reasoned, not spec deviations to worry about):
- Added a `customer_name text not null` column to `invoices` alongside the optional `customer_id` FK — the plan's schema only listed `customer_id`, but "nama klien" was a stated requirement and forcing a pre-existing customer record for every ad-hoc invoice client would be more friction than the feature needs. Selecting an existing customer in the form auto-fills the name (still editable).
- Added a stored `subtotal numeric` column on `invoices` (computed once at creation from line items) rather than joining `invoice_lines` on every list-page render — denormalized but simpler, same pattern as `purchases.amount`.
- Status is **computed automatically** from `dp_amount` vs `subtotal` at creation (`unpaid`/`partial`/`paid`) — no UI path to the `draft` status the check-constraint still allows for future use; the only manual transition built is "Tandai Lunas" (forces `paid`), per the plan's minimal verification bar. No "edit invoice line items after creation" flow was built — only create + mark-paid, since nothing in the plan's verification steps required editing, and a dynamic line-item editor on an existing invoice would have meaningfully expanded scope.
- Invoice numbering: `INV-YYYYMMDD-<6-digit-ms-suffix>` computed in the server action (not a DB sequence/RPC) — same simple timestamp-based approach as `billing/actions.ts`'s order IDs, per the plan's explicit "keep it simple" allowance.
- Server action `createInvoice`/`markInvoicePaid` are called **directly with plain object args from the client** (not via `<form action>`/FormData) — matches the existing precedent in `pay-button.tsx`/`buy-form.tsx` for actions needing structured (non-form-serializable) data like the line-items array.
- `invoice_lines` RLS uses an `exists`-subquery against `invoices.business_id` (same pattern as `journal_lines`→`journal_entries`), but unlike `journal_lines` (select-only, since journal balance is a protected invariant enforced only via RPC), `invoice_lines` grants direct client `for all` since there's no analogous invariant to protect for a plain document table.

Verified E2E in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": created an invoice for existing customer "Budi Santoso" with 2 line items (Rp500rb + Rp200rb = Rp700rb subtotal) and Rp200rb DP → correctly showed "Dibayar Sebagian", Sisa Tagihan Rp500rb; clicked "Tandai Lunas" → status flipped to "Lunas" on both the detail page and the list page immediately (via `router.refresh()`/`revalidatePath`). `tsc`/`eslint` clean.

**Environment note**: unlike Fase 3's new-route Turbopack hiccup ([[test-account-preview]]), this fase's three new nested routes (`invoices`, `invoices/baru`, `invoices/[invoiceId]`) did NOT trigger the sibling-route-404 bug on first server start — so that bug isn't 100% reproducible on every new route, just something to watch for, not something to preemptively double-restart for every time.

**How to apply**: Fase 1-4 are all shipped and committed. Next up when resuming is Fase 5 (Kas Harian, no dependency, quick win) or Fase 6 (Notifikasi/Reminder center — now unblocked since both its dependencies, Fase 2's `contract_end`/`due_date` columns and Fase 4's `invoices` table, are done) per the plan file at `C:\Users\WIN10\.claude\plans\optimized-growing-fountain.md`.

    (p_business_id, '3-001', 'Modal Pemilik', 'modal', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '3-100', 'Laba Ditahan', 'modal', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '4-001', 'Pendapatan Penjualan', 'pendapatan', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '4-002', 'Pendapatan Tiket', 'pendapatan', 'kredit', true),

-- Kas Harian needs a revenue-side counterpart account for ad-hoc cash-in
-- entries (Beban Lain-lain already covers cash-out) — mirrors 5-999,
-- doesn't reuse 4-001 (Pendapatan Penjualan) since that account is reserved
-- for actual sales revenue posted from checkout, not manual cash entries.
create or replace function private.seed_default_accounts(p_business_id uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  insert into public.accounts (business_id, code, name, type, normal_balance, is_system)
  values
    (p_business_id, '1-001', 'Kas & Bank', 'aset', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '1-100', 'Piutang Usaha', 'aset', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '1-200', 'Persediaan', 'aset', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '1-500', 'Peralatan', 'aset', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '1-501', 'Akumulasi Penyusutan', 'aset', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '2-001', 'Utang Dagang', 'kewajiban', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '2-100', 'Utang Gaji', 'kewajiban', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '2-200', 'PPN Keluaran (Utang Pajak)', 'kewajiban', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '3-001', 'Modal Pemilik', 'modal', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '3-100', 'Laba Ditahan', 'modal', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '4-001', 'Pendapatan Penjualan', 'pendapatan', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '4-002', 'Pendapatan Tiket', 'pendapatan', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '4-999', 'Pendapatan Lain-lain', 'pendapatan', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '5-001', 'Beban Pokok Penjualan (HPP)', 'beban', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '5-100', 'Beban Gaji', 'beban', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '5-101', 'Beban Listrik & Air', 'beban', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '5-102', 'Beban Sewa', 'beban', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '5-103', 'Beban Marketing', 'beban', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '5-104', 'Beban Perlengkapan', 'beban', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '5-105', 'Beban Penyusutan', 'beban', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '5-999', 'Beban Lain-lain', 'beban', 'debit', true)
  on conflict (business_id, code) do nothing;
end;
$$;

-- Backfill: every existing business is missing 4-999 since it's new.
do $$
declare
  v_business record;
begin
  for v_business in select id from public.businesses loop
    perform private.seed_default_accounts(v_business.id);
  end loop;
end $$;

**Fase 5 — DONE, committed and E2E-verified 2026-07-14** (`2cd7b5d`): new `kas-harian/page.tsx`+`actions.ts`+`add-cash-form.tsx` — a thin UI over the existing `post_journal_entry` RPC (no new table, per the plan's explicit "one source of accounting truth" requirement), reusing `reports/period.ts`'s today/week/month/all/custom period filter (same UX as Jurnal Transaksi) rather than the day-nav pattern from [[finance-standalone-product]] Fase 3's attendance recap — a deliberate choice since Kas Harian lives in the Akuntansi nav group alongside Jurnal and should feel consistent with it.

**Key implementation finding, worth remembering**: the plan explicitly flagged "cek dulu kode akun sebenarnya di seed daftar-akun sebelum implementasi" — checking confirmed there was **no "Pendapatan Lain-lain" account**, only "Beban Lain-lain" (5-999) for the expense side. Reusing "4-001 Pendapatan Penjualan" (real sales revenue, auto-posted from checkout) for arbitrary manual cash-in would have corrupted that account's meaning in Laba Rugi/Neraca. Added a new migration (`20260714130000_kas_harian_account.sql`) extending `private.seed_default_accounts()` with `4-999 Pendapatan Lain-lain` (mirrors `5-999`), following the exact same `create or replace` + backfill-existing-businesses pattern already established by two prior migrations that extended this same function (`20260710140000_ppn_liability.sql` added 2-200, `20260712150000_ticket_journal_posting.sql` added 4-002/1-501/5-105) — this function has now been extended three times total, each time via full replace + backfill loop, so any future account addition should follow the same pattern.

Kas Masuk posts `debit 1-001 (Kas & Bank) / credit 4-999 (Pendapatan Lain-lain)`; Kas Keluar posts the reverse against `5-999 (Beban Lain-lain)`. The page queries `journal_lines` joined to `journal_entries` filtered to the Kas & Bank account — meaning it shows **every** cash movement through that account regardless of source (manual Kas Harian entries, `penjualan`, `pembelian`, `payroll`, etc.), not just entries created through this new UI, matching the plan's "simple UI, correct accounting underneath, single source of truth" intent.

Now observed 2 out of 3 fases that added brand-new nested routes (Fase 3 and Fase 5, not Fase 4) — still not 100% reproducible, but common enough that hitting an unexpected 404 right after adding a new page route should prompt an immediate clean restart attempt before deeper debugging.
