**Fase 6 — DONE, committed and E2E-verified 2026-07-14** (`e246bc0`): new `notifikasi/page.tsx`, pure read-only aggregation — no new actions.ts, since every category's "resolve" action already exists elsewhere (`purchases`' existing "+ Bayar", `invoices`' "Tandai Lunas" from Fase 4, `payroll`'s existing "Tandai Sudah Dibayar", and editing `employees.contract_end` from Fase 2) — the page just links out to those. Nav entry "Notifikasi" added to the **Lainnya** group (cross-cutting utility, alongside Pengaturan/Aktivitas), not Akuntansi or SDM specifically, since it aggregates both.

Severity is 3-tier (`lewat`/`dekat`/`mendatang`) computed from a plain day-difference against `today` (WIB), with fixed constants (`NEAR_DAYS=7`, `FAR_CUTOFF_DAYS=30` — items further out than this aren't shown at all) per the plan's explicit "start with fixed constants, no settings page" allowance. **THR heuristic**: rather than hardcode a specific Idul Fitri date as fact (Idul Fitri follows the Hijri calendar, shifting ~10-11 days earlier each Gregorian year — not something to guess confidently), added a `THR_REFERENCE_DATE` placeholder constant (`"2027-01-01"`, deliberately far out so it shows nothing until corrected) with a prominent comment telling whoever maintains this to update it annually once the official date is announced — same "edit before this is real" convention as the placeholder prices in `plans.ts`/`desktop-products.ts`. `THR_WINDOW_DAYS=60` (wider than the 7/30 day purchase/invoice/contract windows) since THR prep needs more lead time.

Payslip "belum dibayar" total is computed with the exact same formula as `payroll/page.tsx` (`base_pay + lembur_amount + thr_amount + tunjangan - potongan`) for consistency between the two pages.

**Environment note**: no new-route Turbopack 404 this time despite `notifikasi` being a brand-new nested route — 3rd fase in a row without it recurring (only Fase 3 and Fase 5 hit it so far), reinforcing it's real but not consistently reproducible.

**How to apply**: Fase 1-6 are all shipped and committed. Next up when resuming is Fase 7 (period sync across report pages) or Fase 8 (visual redesign, sub-phased) per the plan file at `C:\Users\WIN10\.claude\plans\optimized-growing-fountain.md` — Fase 9 (marketing page) still just needs Fase 1, already satisfied, but is listed later since ideally some of Fase 8 lands first so the promoted look is representative.

input.new_string:
**Fase 7 — DONE, committed and E2E-verified 2026-07-14** (`a6f4de7`): 10 files touched — 9 existing consumers of `reports/period.ts` (kas-harian, ticket-reports, reports/page, reports/cogs, reports/laba-rugi, accounting/laba-rugi, accounting/jurnal, accounting/modal, accounting/arus-kas) plus `finance/page.tsx` which had its own **incompatible local** `Period = "today"|"week"|"month"|"all"` type (no `"custom"`) — migrated onto the shared type/`getPeriodRange`/`parsePeriod`. `reports/price-trend/page.tsx` was deliberately left untouched — its `Period = "30"|"90"|"all"` is a different, unrelated concept (lookback window for a price chart, not a calendar period) despite sharing the name.

**Mechanism**: new `PERIOD_COOKIE_NAME` constant in `reports/period.ts` (plain string, safe to import from both server pages and the new client component) + a new shared `reports/period-tabs.tsx` **client component** (`"use client"`) that renders the same pill-tab UI every page used to duplicate inline, and on click does `document.cookie = "kk_period=<value>; path=/; max-age=1y"` before letting the `<Link>` navigate normally (no `preventDefault`, so soft-navigation still works). Each of the 10 server pages now resolves its period as `parsePeriod(periodParam ?? (await cookies()).get(PERIOD_COOKIE_NAME)?.value)` instead of just `parsePeriod(periodParam)`. Deliberately **not** done via `proxy.ts`/middleware — reading the cookie is a normal `next/headers` `cookies()` call inside each Server Component, which the plan's own "server-component + searchParams" preference pointed at directly; a middleware redirect layer would have been a heavier, less transparent way to get the same result.

**Scope decision**: only the period **type** (today/week/month/all/custom) is remembered — custom's specific `from`/`to` dates are not persisted (they're page-specific typed input, impractical to globally sync the same way). One consequence observed during verification: clicking "📅 Kustom" itself (even before filling dates) remembers `period=custom` in the cookie; visiting another page next with no dates set then falls back to `getPeriodRange`'s empty-custom-range behavior, which is equivalent to "all" (both bounds null) — not a bug, just the natural consequence of not syncing the dates themselves. Not worth engineering around.

**`finance/page.tsx` column-type nuance carried over correctly**: `transactions.date` is `timestamptz` (filtered directly with `fromIso`/`toIsoExclusive`), but `expenses.date`/`reconciliations.date`/`inventory_snapshots.date` are plain `date` columns — filtered with `fromIso.slice(0,10)`/`toIsoExclusive.slice(0,10)`, the exact same trim-to-date-part pattern `reports/laba-rugi/page.tsx` already established for its own `expenses` query. The opening-inventory-snapshot lookup (previously keyed off a local `periodStartStr`) now keys off `fromIso` the same way, preserving its original "known period start vs. all-time earliest snapshot" branching logic.

Verified E2E on "Toko Test Laporan": clicked "Bulan Ini" on Jurnal Transaksi → confirmed `kk_period=month` cookie set → navigated to Kas Harian, Perubahan Modal, and Keuangan (finance) with no `?period=` in the URL → all three defaulted to "Bulan ini" instead of resetting to "Hari Ini". Confirmed `finance` now offers and correctly handles "📅 Kustom" (tested a single-day custom range 2026-07-09–2026-07-09 → numbers matched exactly the 3 expenses dated that day, Rp0 revenue as expected). Confirmed CSV export links (`reports/export?type=...&period=month`) stay consistent with whatever period is currently active, since the `periodQuery`-building code itself was untouched. `tsc`/`eslint` clean across all 12 files, existing `reports/period.test.ts` (10 tests) still passes unmodified.

**How to apply**: Fase 1-7 are all shipped and committed. Next up when resuming is Fase 8 (visual redesign, sub-phased 8a/8b/8c) or Fase 10 (Excel export, no dependency, quick win) per the plan file at `C:\Users\WIN10\.claude\plans\optimized-growing-fountain.md` — Fase 9 (marketing page) still just needs Fase 1, already satisfied, but is listed later since ideally some of Fase 8 lands first so the promoted look is representative.
